sessions.title: 6 × 1 km @ 5:00/km
sessions.detail: 90 s jog recovery. This is the race: eight 1 km efforts off fatigue. Start conservative — the first sessions rebuild a capacity you had in April.

sessions.title: Easy run — 6 km
sessions.detail: Genuinely easy, HR under 150. Puts a floor under the week; your week-to-week swing hurts more than low mileage does.

sessions.title: Long run — 23 km easy
sessions.detail: Conversational, HR under 155. Up 2 km from your 21.2 km ceiling — the only sustainable way back to the 22 km Phase 2b wants.

sessions.title: Optional: tempo 5–8 km @ 6:00/km or quicker
sessions.detail: Only if the three above are done. Comfortably hard, HR in the 155–170 band — the pace you could hold for an hour. This is what most of your running already drifts into by accident; doing it deliberately once a week is worth more than three runs that all land there.
